claims.text: Named Entity Recognition (NER) involves the identification of entities such as proteins, genes, diseases, treatments, and drugs in biomedical texts.
NER is a part of Biomedical Information Extraction, which applies Natural Language Processing techniques to extract relevant information from texts.
Machine learning and deep learning techniques are commonly used to enhance the performance of NER systems in biomedical applications.
